---
title: "About R+AI"
---

R+AI 2026 is an R Consortium event focused on artificial intelligence with R. The program will include keynotes, talks, workshops, and community discussions.

## Goals

- Showcase practical AI with R across industries.
- Share advances in modeling, large language models, and responsible AI.
- Connect the community through hands-on learning.

## Quick Facts

**Dates:** November 10-11, 2026  
**Location:** 100% online  
**CFP:** Closed  
**Community:** Speakers participate in live Q&A  
**Recordings:** Talks will be recorded  
**Time Zone:** Schedule is US Eastern Time Zone  
**Pricing:** Industry, Academia, and Student level ticketing are all available

## Registration Pricing

The following table lists the registration fees for three categories of attendees: students, academics and members of non-profit organizations, and professionals employed in industry who do not have non-profit status. Early bird rates apply until October 12, 2026. All prices are in U.S. dollars.

| Category | Early Bird (until Oct 12) | Price |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Students | $15 | $30 |
| Academic / Non-profit | $35 | $50 |
| Industry | $45 | $70 |
